query: Digital Twin Market - Infrastructure, Utilities & Smart Cities

market_analysis.market_type_reason: B2B: the buyers are businesses, utilities and public agencies (Construction, real estate, utilities, telecom, transportation, manufacturing, government/smart cities, energy and utilities).
market_analysis.market_definition: The India Digital Twin Market - Infrastructure, Utilities & Smart Cities covers companies providing the following. Products and technology: Twin type: asset twin, network twin, city twin; enabling technology: IoT, AI/ML, BIM, GIS, drone/LiDAR, cloud, edge computing; visualization: 2D/3D dashboards, BIM viewer, 3D city model. Services and business models: Twin-platform subscription, reality-capture service, BIM-to-twin integration, IoT integration, simulation and scenario modeling, managed digital-twin operations. Applications: Design and construction, operations and maintenance, predictive maintenance, asset performance, safety, sustainability, urban planning, remote monitoring. End users: Construction, real estate, utilities, telecom, transportation, manufacturing, government/smart cities, energy and utilities. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player itself provides digital-twin solutions for infrastructure, utilities and smart cities under its own name: asset, network or city twin platforms, BIM-to-twin and GIS / IoT integration, reality-capture (drone / LiDAR / 3D city model) services, simulation and scenario modelling, and managed digital-twin operations for construction, utilities, transport, telecom and government.
adjacent_segments: Manufacturing-only or product digital-twin vendors with no infrastructure, utility or city twin
General IoT or cloud platforms with no digital-twin product
General IT services firms with no digital-twin practice

rejected_mid.name: EngenX
rejected_mid.reason: Headquartered in Jamshedpur, India, its core product is an AI-powered Industrial Digital Twin platform focused entirely on smart manufacturing, OEMs, predictive maintenance of rotating machinery, and smart mining asset logs, with no core focus on utility networks or smart cities.

rejected_mid.name: CY4 Digital Twin Products & Solutions Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: Headquartered in Chennai, India, its core business operates strictly in manufacturing engineering and digital factory workflows, offering vehicle build validation (BuildIQ), robot path simulations (FlowIQ), 3D factory layout layouts, and industrial time studies rather than infrastructure/city platforms.

rejected_mid.name: Vegam Solutions
rejected_mid.reason: The company's primary focus is manufacturing, digital factory, and industrial IoT (Industry 4.0) for plants and manufacturing infrastructure, rather than smart cities, utilities, or public infrastructure landscapes.

rejected_mid.name: Kreayotoo Solutions Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: While it lists a digital twin module (dGT), its primary business is acting as a civil engineering design consultancy, master planner, and technical process advisory firm rather than a product/solution provider operating natively in this software segment.

rejected_mid.name: Intrino Technologies Pvt Ltd
rejected_mid.reason: Primary focus is industrial/factory digital twins, additive manufacturing, product design, and custom immersive XR training applications rather than smart cities, utilities, or regional public infrastructure projects.

rejected_mid.name: Ecolibrium Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: Ecolibrium's primary platform, SmartSense, targets industrial manufacturing, manufacturing asset efficiency, commercial buildings/real estate, and data centers for energy management and decarbonization, placing it in manufacturing/product and facility IoT rather than the specific infrastructure/utility/smart city twin scope.

rejected_mid.name: Black Box Network Services India Pvt. Ltd.
rejected_mid.reason: It is a subsidiary of a multinational firm headquartered globally in Lawrence, Pennsylvania, USA (owned by Essar), violating the strict condition requiring the global headquarters to be in India.

rejected_mid.name: Touchwizard Technologies Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: Its digital twin/real estate 3D platform brand PropVR was acquired and fully absorbed by Square Yards in 2021. The business no longer trades as an independent brand or solution provider under its own name in this market.

rejected_mid.name: Cogneau Systems Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: The company's platform, VERDIS, specializes entirely in manufacturing supply chains, FMCG logistics, and industrial value chain decision-making twins, which is explicitly excluded from infrastructure, utilities, and city twin platforms.

rejected_mid.name: Netsol Water Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: Netsol Water is primarily an industrial engineering manufacturer and builder of turn-key water/wastewater plants (STPs, ETPs, RO systems) rather than a software or core digital twin platform vendor. While their blog content references digital twin concepts, they are physically constructing industrial machinery rather than operating as a standalone Digital Twin Solution Provider.

rejected_mid.name: Utthunga Technologies Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: The company's primary focus is industrial automation software services, Industry 4.0, and IoT engineering for industrial manufacturing, process plants, and OEMs. It does not primarily provide asset, network, or city twin platforms specifically for infrastructure, utilities, or smart cities.

rejected_mid.name: Effe Technology Pvt Ltd
rejected_mid.reason: The company is primarily an Extended Reality (XR), AR/VR development studio and agency focusing on product visualization, medical training simulations, marketing, and factory floor walkthroughs. It is not a core infrastructure, utility, or smart city twin platform provider.

rejected_mid.name: Crediff Engineering Pvt. Ltd.
rejected_mid.reason: The company operates primarily as a BIM consultancy and outsourcing agency providing modeling services (Revit, Navisworks) for the AEC industry. It does not own or provide a native digital twin platform for infrastructure or smart cities.

rejected_mid.name: Zwilling Labs Private Limited
rejected_mid.reason: An IIT Bombay-incubated startup whose primary business is building AI-powered digital twin platforms (Zwillio) for machine telemetry, smart manufacturing, mining exploration, and factory floor optimization, which falls out of the infrastructure/smart city scope.
